environment.description: Service deployed in isolated VPC (10.200.0.0/16) on ECS Fargate tasks in private subnets with no IGW/NAT attached. Consumers connect exclusively through com.amazonaws.vpce.us-east-1.vpce-svc-0a1b2c3d4e5f67890 interface endpoint. VPC endpoint policy restricts aws:PrincipalOrgID to o-abc123def4. The endpoint's associated security group (sg-0fedcba987654) permits inbound TCP/8080 only from CIDR 10.100.0.0/16 (consumer VPC). Route tables for the private subnets contain no 0.0.0.0/0 route. Additionally, the NLB target group has a per-target connection limit and the Fargate task definition sets containerDefinitions[0].ulimits with nofile soft/hard at 1024 and ECS service has a deployment circuit breaker enabled with rollback.

config.deployment: ECS Fargate in private subnets (no IGW, no NAT)
config.nlb_config: internal NLB with connection-based target group
